specification.problem: Characterize the time-averaged position distribution of a recycled-coin discrete-time quantum walk on the cycle graph C_N as a function of a real memory parameter in [0,8], the initial state, and N mod 4. The abstract does not give the recycled-coin coin operator, so only generic walk and time-averaging background can be written.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful construction: a generic coined discrete-time quantum walk on C_N with a placeholder parameter-dependent coin C(m), plus the time-averaged distribution. Tiny instance assumed: N=4 (N mod 4 = 0) with a single coin qubit. The recycled-coin update rule, the specific coin form, the claimed non-uniform parameter values, and the proved relationship to the other memory-based walk are outside scope.

equations.label: Conditional shift on cycle
equations.description: Coin-conditioned move on the cycle, with position arithmetic modulo N.
equations.justification: Standard coined walk on a cycle; the shift convention is an assumption, not from the abstract.
assumptions: Coin value 0 moves right and 1 moves left

equations.description: Placeholder evolution with a parameter-dependent coin.
equations.justification: The abstract says that the memory parameter affects the coin flip operator but gives no form for it; the recycled-coin dynamics may not be a fixed coin.
assumptions: C(m) is a placeholder, not the recycled-coin rule

equations.label: Position distribution
equations.description: Probability of finding the walker at x after t steps.
equations.justification: Born rule on the position register.

equations.label: Time-averaged distribution
equations.description: Time-averaged distribution studied in the abstract. The uniform case corresponds to 1/N for every x.
equations.abstract_quote: we will consider its time averaged distribution
equations.justification: The abstract names the time-averaged distribution as the object of study; the explicit formula is the standard definition.

steps.description: Prepare the initial position and coin state.
Apply the placeholder coin C(m) and the conditional shift S repeatedly for t steps.
Obtain the position distribution at each t and average over t to get the time-averaged distribution, then compare with uniform 1/N.

specification.measurement: Measure the position register in the computational basis after t steps, with t chosen at random from 0..T-1, to estimate the time-averaged distribution.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Histogram the outcomes, compare with 1/N, and scan m in [0,8], the initial state and N mod 4.
assumptions: The recycled-coin rule is not specified, so a standard coined walk with a parameter-dependent coin is a placeholder
N=4 and a single coin qubit are chosen as the instance
